list: Official 55-trophy list, names, descriptions and grades as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
note: Guides are written for this entry in the author's own words. Each guide cites the sources its facts come from; official names and descriptions are shown exactly as published.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task. Work through the roadmap in order: finish the story, clear the stranger strands, then sweep activities and collectibles, and save the 100% completion trophy for last, since it is the longest grind of the set.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Follow the roadmap stages in this guide, from the story playthrough to the 100% cleanup.
Check the in-game Progress menu regularly so you can see which trophies are still outstanding.
Earn the gold 100% completion trophy last; the platinum follows it immediately.

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission of the game, so it unlocks in the first hour of play. Play through the intro, follow the on-screen prompts, and finish the mission as directed — there is nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening sequence.
Follow the prompts through the Gone Fishing mission until its closing scene plays.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter's closing scene plays. Chapters flow one into the next, so just keep playing the gold story markers on the map. Before the chapter ends, do the first meditation spot on Lucia's balcony — see Positive Mental Attitude — because that spot may not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the gold story missions in order until Chapter 1 ends.
Before leaving Chapter 1, meditate on Lucia's balcony in the morning after the mission Down to Earth.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's close. There is no mission replay in GTA VI, so make a manual save at the start of each chapter — it is your only way back if you want to redo a mission for fun or for a missed optional objective.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Make a manual save as Chapter 2 begins.
Play the gold story missions in order until the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's close. Keep taking the side missions and stranger strands as they appear on the map — several of them only unlock during the story, and finishing them now saves backtracking after the credits.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Make a manual save as Chapter 3 begins.
Play the gold story missions in order, picking up stranger strands as they appear.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's close. Chapter 4 is where the big heist missions land — Break the Bank, Hi-Jacked and Snow Storm are all story missions in this stretch, so their trophies will pop along the way.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Make a manual save as Chapter 4 begins.
Play the gold story missions in order until the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy pops with the credits. After the credits roll, free-roam opens up with everything still available — nothing in the game is locked behind the ending, so the whole cleanup phase happens after this trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end and watch the credits.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission — play it when its marker appears and finish it to the end. Story mission trophies like this one unlock as you play the campaign in order, so there is no separate requirement beyond completing the mission itself.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Follow the gold marker to the Breakfast Run mission when it appears.
Complete the mission through its closing scene.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission. It unlocks during the campaign — take the gold marker when it appears, play the heist through to its end, and the trophy pops. Heists in GTA VI are long, multi-part missions, so set aside a solid session for it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Follow the gold marker to The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story.
Complete the heist through its closing scene.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission — play it when its marker appears and finish it to the end. Like the other named-mission trophies, it unlocks from the campaign alone, so the only requirement is reaching it in the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Follow the gold marker to the Child's Play mission when it appears.
Complete the mission through its closing scene.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission — play it when its marker appears and finish it to the end. The mission's name doubles as the trophy's name, which is the pattern for all the named-mission trophies in this list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Follow the gold marker to the Headliners mission when it appears.
Complete the mission through its closing scene.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Play it when its gold marker appears and finish it to the end. The airport also matters for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout — you will be back here in free-roam.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Follow the gold marker to the VCIA Takedown mission when it appears.
Complete the mission through its closing scene.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission — play it when its marker appears and finish it to the end. It is one of the later named missions, so it arrives deep in the campaign, close to the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Follow the gold marker to the Operation Savage Glory mission when it appears.
Complete the mission through its closing scene.

trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the long one — roughly half the platinum's total time. After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. The checklist is lenient: most categories count partial progress, so you do not need every vehicle or every animal, only the share the checklist asks for. The categories that do need everything are the robberies, the underwater discoveries, the shooting ranges, the drone races and Bret's quests — finish those in full and let the partial categories carry the rest.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Push Square: GTA 6 PS5 trophies revealed

steps: Finish the story first; the checklist only makes sense in free-roam after the credits.
Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist top to bottom.
Complete the all-or-nothing categories in full: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
For the partial categories, reach the checklist's threshold rather than collecting everything.

trophies.guide: Stunts are the game's driving tricks — jumps, near misses, wheelies, stoppies and drifts — and every one you pull off adds to the count of 250. The total builds passively across the whole game, so just drive aggressively: take ramps and stunt jumps whenever you see them, thread through traffic at speed, and use the longer highway runs for repeated near misses. If you still need some after the story, loop the marked stunt jumps, which respawn and count every time.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast and take every ramp and stunt jump you pass; each counts toward the 250.
Chain near misses in highway traffic and drift through corners for extra stunt events.
After the story, loop the marked stunt jumps to mop up the remainder.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are nine activity types in the game, and you only need to try each one once — no win or score required. Open the Activities tab in the pause menu to see the full list, then sample one of each: fishing, the shooting range, a drone race, an arcade game, bowling, meditation, hunting, a street race and one more from the list. This is a sampler trophy, so knock it out in one free-roam session.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the pause menu and check the Activities tab for the nine types.
Try one of each type once — just starting and finishing the activity is enough.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the Ammu-Nation ranges, and every one needs a gold medal. Each challenge is a short timed shooting drill with a score threshold for gold — learn the target pattern on a first run, then replay it immediately while the layout is fresh in your mind. Use the weapon the challenge gives you, aim for headshots where they pay, and reload between waves so you are never caught mid-animation. The ranges also count toward 100% completion, so golding them here helps there too.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit an Ammu-Nation shooting range and open the challenge list.
Run each challenge once to learn its targets, then replay for the gold score threshold.
Work through all 42 challenges; the trophy pops on the last gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at 14 locations around Leonida, and you need a win at every one of them. Each race is a checkpoint course flown with a drone — learn the course on a first attempt, then race it properly: cut corners where the checkpoints allow, keep the drone low through gates, and brake early for tight turns rather than overshooting them. Winning all 14 also completes the drone-race part of the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location and enter the race.
Learn the checkpoint route on a practice run, then race for the win.
Repeat at all 14 locations; the trophy pops on the last win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses, not the same race 20 times. Street races, circuit races and off-road events all count as long as each course is one you have not won before. Pick a fast, grippy car, learn each course's braking points on the first lap, and use the slipstream on straights to pass the pack early so you are not fighting traffic in the final corners.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter a race you have never won and take first place.
Move on to a new course each time; repeats of a won race do not count.
Win 20 different courses in total.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival you meet at the docks, and this trophy asks you to beat him in a head-to-head fishing challenge. Fishing works on a cast-and-reel rhythm: cast where the fish are showing, wait for the bite, then reel steadily without letting the line go slack or snap. Against Cal, focus on landing the bigger fish rather than the most fish — one heavy catch is worth more than three small ones.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Go fishing and meet Cal at the fishing spot.
Enter his fishing challenge when the prompt appears.
Out-fish him by landing the heavier catches, then finish the challenge.

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet — in an arcade, a bar or a similar venue — pick a game and play it through to its end. Any arcade game counts, and you only need to complete one, so choose the shortest or easiest cabinet you find and see it through to its finish screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the world.
Start a game and play it through to its completion screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the side characters with his own mission strand. His missions unlock as the story progresses — take each one when its marker appears and see the strand through to its final mission. Side strands like Andy's are part of the stranger and character content, so finishing them also feeds the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Take Andy's missions as their markers appear during and after the story.
Complete each mission in the strand until the final one ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton has his own mission strand that unlocks as the story progresses. Take each mission when its marker appears and see the strand through to its final mission — the trophy pops when that last mission ends. Do the strand as it unlocks rather than leaving it all for after the credits.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's missions as their markers appear during and after the story.
Complete each mission in the strand until the final one ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy has his own mission strand that unlocks as the story progresses. Take each mission when its marker appears and see the strand through to its final mission — the trophy pops when that last mission ends. His strand is one of five character strands, alongside Andy, Kenton, Randy and Tyrone.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Take Billy's missions as their markers appear during and after the story.
Complete each mission in the strand until the final one ends.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks strands are the question-mark missions scattered across Leonida. Eight full strands are needed: pick up each stranger's first mission when its marker appears, then keep taking the follow-ups until that stranger's story is done. The five character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — count toward the eight, so finishing those five leaves only three more stranger strands to find in the world.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish the five character strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Find three more stranger strands on the map and complete each one in full.
The trophy pops when the eighth strand is done.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy has his own mission strand that unlocks as the story progresses. Take each mission when its marker appears and see the strand through to its final mission — the trophy pops when that last mission ends. Randy's strand also counts toward the eight strands of Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Take Randy's missions as their markers appear during and after the story.
Complete each mission in the strand until the final one ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone has his own mission strand that unlocks as the story progresses. Take each mission when its marker appears and see the strand through to its final mission — the trophy pops when that last mission ends. With Tyrone done, all five character strands are finished.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as their markers appear during and after the story.
Complete each mission in the strand until the final one ends.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and you must meditate at every one of them. The first spot is the important one: Lucia meditates on the balcony at Jason's house on the morning after the mission Down to Earth, in Chapter 1, and reports say that spot disappears after Chapter 1. Do it while you are there, before the chapter ends. The remaining spots are spread across the map — beaches, hilltops and quiet corners — and the game marks them once you find them. Note the counts disagree between sources: the 100% checklist counts 15 spots while the trophy needs 18, so visit all 18 and you cover both.
trophies.missable_note: First spot (Lucia's balcony, morning after Down to Earth, Chapter 1) is reported to disappear after Chapter 1. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, on the morning after Down to Earth, meditate on the balcony at Jason's house.
After the story, sweep the remaining meditation spots across Leonida.
Meditate at all 18 spots; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is the hunting contact, and this trophy asks you to hunt a unique animal for him — a one-of-a-kind creature rather than ordinary wildlife. Track it with the hunting tools: look for its trail, follow the signs, and take the shot cleanly when you have it. Which animal it is has not been confirmed in the published guides yet — check the in-game hunting prompts for Bret's quest and follow them to the creature. Hunting quests also feed the 100% checklist, so Bret's strand is worth finishing in full.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Pick up Bret's hunting quests and follow his prompts.
Track the unique animal using the trail and signs the game shows.
Take the animal down cleanly and complete Bret's quest.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in packs, and completing a set means finding every card in it. Three full sets are needed for this silver trophy. Cards are tucked into shops, interiors and out-of-the-way corners, so check every building you enter and use the in-game collection tracker to see which cards each set is still missing. Finish three sets and the trophy pops — you do not need every set in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up collectible cards wherever you find them and check the collection tracker.
Focus on completing one set at a time using the tracker's missing-card list.
Complete three full sets.

trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing app, and this trophy asks you to WAiNK It — post a photo — at 100 different locations. Travel the map and post at each new spot: landmarks, beaches, neighbourhoods and viewpoints all count as locations. The fastest route is a road trip around Leonida's edge, stopping to post at every named place you pass. It pairs naturally with The Goodtime State, since both reward covering the whole map.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open WAiNK at a named location and post a photo there.
Repeat at new locations as you travel — each distinct location counts once.
Post at 100 locations in total.

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's side objectives — driving feats, combat feats, exploration goals and more — listed in the Challenges menu. You need 50 of them done. Pick the easy ones first: the driving and exploration challenges fall quickly in normal play, while the combat ones come naturally in missions and free-roam fights. The 100% checklist counts 70 of 80 challenges, so the 50 you do here are a down payment on that bigger total.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the Challenges menu and sort by the easiest categories.
Clear the driving and exploration challenges first.
Keep completing challenges in normal play until 50 are done.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be present for the whole escape — if they leave or get busted, it does not count. Build the wanted level by causing chaos with your partner in the car, then break line of sight, hide in an alley or a parking garage, and wait for the wanted stars to fade. Doing it at night, away from the city centre, makes the escape much easier.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Have your partner with you, then raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars fade.
Escape cleanly with your partner still with you.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan the route first: pick three shops close together on a quiet street, hit them one after another, and keep moving between them so the cops never catch up. Do not stop to fight or loot — speed is what keeps the wanted level alive across all three robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop and move straight to the next without losing the wanted level.
Rob all three in a row; the trophy pops after the third.

trophies.guide: Discovering a vehicle means getting close enough for the game to log it — drive past it, walk up to it, or sit in it. You need 100 different vehicles, and Leonida is full of them: traffic, parked cars, boats, bikes and aircraft all count. Cruise the highways and city streets, scan every new model you pass, and check the vehicle log to see what you are still missing. The 100% checklist counts a share of the full vehicle list, so this trophy is a step toward that too.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive through varied areas — city, highway, countryside, docks — and pass new vehicles.
Get close to each new model so the game logs it as discovered.
Discover 100 different vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode, and this trophy needs five enemies downed in one single use of it. Set it up: find a group of five or more enemies standing close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them fast while time is slowed. Use a weapon with a high fire rate, aim for the head, and do not let the mode end before the fifth enemy falls.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a spot with five or more enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and down all five before it ends.
If it fails, retry — enemies respawn and the attempt costs nothing.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is Vice City International Airport, and an unscheduled departure means leaving in an aircraft without going through the normal channels — steal a plane or helicopter from the airport and take off. Expect an immediate wanted level, so take off fast, climb steeply, and get out of the airport's airspace before the response builds up.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport on foot or by car.
Take an aircraft from the tarmac and take off without clearance.
Leave the airport's airspace to complete the departure.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and the exact trigger has not been confirmed in the published guides yet — most likely it involves a Rhino tank, either stealing one, surviving one, or taking one on. If you spot a Rhino in a military area or a mission, engage with it: steal it if you can, or survive its fire. This guide will be updated here once a source confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank in a military area or a mission.
Steal it or survive an encounter with it.
Check the trophy list after the encounter to confirm the trigger.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without any detection — no alarms, no witnesses calling it in, no camera spotting you. Go at night, move quietly, take out the cameras first if you can, and grab the goods fast. If anything spots you, leave and come back another night rather than fighting it out: a clean run is what the trophy counts.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and scout it first in the daytime.
Return at night, avoid cameras and witnesses, and take the goods.
Leave undetected; if you are spotted, abort and retry another night.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults are the big robberies: five of them, each robbed and escaped cleanly. Each vault needs planning — scout the bank, find the vault, crack it, then escape with the cops on you. Bring a fast getaway car, plan the exit route before you go in, and do not linger once the money is in hand. Five successful vault jobs earn this silver trophy, and vault robberies also count toward the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Scout a bank and locate its vault.
Rob the vault, grab the cash, and escape the police.
Repeat at five different bank vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then escape the police that respond. The simplest approach is to ram it off the road or block it with your car, then blow the rear doors and grab the money before the response arrives. Have a fast car waiting and a route out of the area planned before you start.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck driving its route.
Stop it, crack the rear doors, and take the cash.
Escape the police response cleanly.

trophies.guide: Leonida is divided into 52 areas, and you must visit every one of them. The map tracks which areas you have been to, so open it and look for the gaps — the far corners of the state, the islands and the rural counties are the ones most players miss. A slow drive around the state's edge, then a sweep through the interior, covers everything. Pair this with the WAiNK trophy, since both reward covering the whole map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Open the map and note which areas are still unvisited.
Drive the state's edge, then sweep the interior and the islands.
Visit all 52 areas.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida, and you must rob one operation belonging to each of them. Operations are marked on the map once you find them — look for gang territory markers and the operation sites inside them. Rob one per gang, escape cleanly, and the trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is hit. This is a good trophy to do alongside the bank vaults, since the approach is the same: scout, hit fast, escape.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation in each gang's territory.
Rob one operation per gang and escape.
Hit all nine gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or beach spot with a view over the water, and order a cocktail. This is a pure flavour trophy — no skill, no grind, just being in the right place and ordering the right drink. Do it the first time you are on the beachfront in the early game and it is done.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach on the Vice City beachfront.
Find a bar with a view over the water and order a cocktail.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the glass — the classic GTA move. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, drive in, then floor it straight back out through the windows. The trophy is about the spectacle, so any showroom and any car will do.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass front.
Drive in, then smash out through the glass in the same car.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — follow-through means completing your throw properly, so play a full frame rather than just walking in. Any game at that alley counts, and it pairs with the Ten Pin trophy if you want to combine a bowling visit with a drive-by. The alley is a named location, so look for its sign in Vice City.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City.
Play a game of bowling through at least one full frame.

trophies.guide: The description points at the partnership between the two leads, Lucia and Jason, and the exact trigger has not been confirmed in the published guides yet — most likely it is a story or relationship moment that comes up naturally in play. Keep playing the story and the side content with your partner, and check the trophy list after partnership scenes. This guide will be updated here once a source confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the story and partner missions as they come.
Check the trophy list after partnership scenes in the story.

trophies.guide: GTA VI tracks the choices you make, and the trophy list shows a count for this one that runs up to 500 — so it is about making choices, not one single decision. Play the story and the side content, and take the choices as they come: dialogue options, mission decisions, how you treat people. The count builds across the whole game, and the trophy pops when the tally is reached. The exact threshold has not been confirmed in the published guides yet.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the story and make the choices each mission offers.
Keep choosing in side content and free-roam encounters.
The trophy pops when the tracked choice count is reached.

trophies.guide: The description points at succeeding on a second attempt — most likely retrying something you failed once and passing it the second time. If you fail a mission, an activity or a challenge, retry it right away rather than moving on: the retry is probably what this trophy counts. The exact trigger has not been confirmed in the published guides yet, so treat any second attempt as a chance and check the list after a successful retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: If you fail a mission or activity, retry it immediately.
Succeed on the second attempt and check the trophy list.

trophies.guide: The description points at witnessing something strange — the classic GTA paranormal or easter-egg moment, like a UFO sighting or an unexplained event in the world. Strange encounters in GTA games usually happen at specific places and times, often at night in remote spots. Explore the odd corners of Leonida after dark, keep an eye on the sky, and the moment will find you. The exact trigger has not been confirmed in the published guides yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore remote and unusual spots around Leonida, especially at night.
Watch for strange events in the world and stay to witness one.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means attacking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — a bat, a knife or your fists — and this trophy asks you to knock someone over with one. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, lean out and swing as you pass. It is easiest at low speed in a quiet street where you can line the pass up cleanly. The bowling name is the joke: you are bowling the person over.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian and swing as you pass.
Knock them over with the drive-by hit.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money you pick up from robberies and heists, and your contacts can launder them into clean cash. You need $250,000 laundered in total — it accumulates across the whole game, so launder every batch of marked bills as soon as you have it rather than letting it sit. Bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations are the best sources of marked bills, so this trophy grows naturally alongside the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies, vaults and heists.
Launder each batch through your contacts as soon as you have it.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, anything the shops sell. The total accumulates across the whole game, so it will be most of the way done by the time you finish the story if you buy gear as you go. If you are short at the end, the fastest top-up is expensive ammo and weapon upgrades at Ammu-Nation, which count like any other purchase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy weapons, clothes and gear as you play; every shop purchase counts.
Check the in-game stats to see how much you have spent.
Top up at Ammu-Nation with ammo and upgrades if you are short.

trophies.guide: There are eight garage properties to buy across Leonida, and this trophy needs all of them. Garages are bought from the in-game property listings — save up, then buy them one at a time as you can afford them. They are also practical: each one is a place to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good and register for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Open the property listings and find the eight garages.
Buy each one as you can afford it.
Own all eight garages.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the in-game vehicle app, and this trophy asks you to register ten vehicles to it. Find a vehicle, get in it, and register it through the app — ten different vehicles in total. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you discover for Whip It Good and the trophy will be most of the way done before you even focus on it.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find a vehicle and get in it.
Register it through the Scooter Bros app.
Register ten different vehicles.
